description: High-fidelity clone of Mystery Tarot web app with Next.js

database_schema.tarot_cards: 78 completed cards with aspects (love, career, etc.), upright, reversed, keywords, numerology, planet, zodiac. Located in src/json/tarot.ts.
database_schema.tarot_themes: Centralized taxonomy of main themes, sub-themes, and 1000+ contextual preset questions. Located in src/json/tarot_themes.ts.

features.name: Journey Form Modal refactored with Taxonomy & Typography fixes
Tarot Reading Flow UI & Deck Logic hook

business_rules: Images are served statically from public/cards/
UX focuses on ritualized interaction with GSAP micro-animations and framer-motion
CSS uses Tailwind CSS v4 utility classes
Journey Form uses createPortal and disables click-outside-to-close to preserve flow
Typography: Use Cormorant Garamond, Cormorant SC, Playfair Display and EB Garamond with 'vietnamese' subset to support Vietnamese language natively.
